components: a horizontal across the upper left
a long stroke down through it, looping at the foot and sweeping right
a small separate mark at the upper right
strokeOrder: draw the horizontal from left to right across the upper left
lift; begin above the horizontal, come down through it, loop anticlockwise at the foot and sweep out to the right
lift; add the small separate mark at the upper right
strokeOrderNote: Sirgazil's 32-frame animation moves the start marker twice, which is two pen lifts and three strokes; the small right-hand mark is drawn last and is never joined to the body.

strokeOrderSource.citation: Sirgazil, Hiragana む stroke order animation.gif, hiragana む, 32 frames, 3.2 seconds (Wikimedia Commons, 1 October 2009)
strokeOrderSource.variation: The CC0 animation draws む as three strokes in the order horizontal, body-with-loop, right-hand mark. KanjiVG's data for U+3080 holds three paths in the same order. The loop at the foot is drawn anticlockwise; its size varies in handwriting, but the three-stroke order does not.

notes: The mu of むっつ, six things. The small mark on the right is a separate stroke and is the one most often left off; a む without it is not a む.
